summary: Home Manager can use a stable executable path owned by an external deployer without installing or restarting Smalltalk when its package changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The default Home Manager configuration is unchanged. The optional services.smalltalk.binary.path applies to Linux and macOS. No wire or client change.

downtime.detail: No required downtime. Switching binary ownership changes the service configuration and may restart the daemon once.

manual.detail: No required step. To opt in, set services.smalltalk.binary.path to the external deployer's stable absolute executable path. That deployer must install the executable and manage upgrade restarts.

recovery.detail: Set binary.path back to null to restore Home Manager installation and package-triggered restarts.
